title: Ronin rumble
tagline: Oncahin autobalet with trustless execution and 1v1 beting. Fun game.
description:
Ronin Rumble: Web3 auto-battler with provably fair battles. Play
  1v1/multiplayer matches with RON entry fees. ROFL TEE ensures
  trustless combat results. Winner takes 91.7%. Built on Ronin + Oasis for ETHGlobal.
 Solution:
  1. Player calls createMatch() → sends RON entry fee
  2. Contract holds funds in escrow
  3. Game server (authorized address) calls endMatch(winner)
  4. Contract calculates prizes:
     - Winner: entryFee * 2 * 0.917 = 91.7%
     - Platform: entryFee * 2 * 0.083 = 8.3%
  5. Automatic transfer to winner
how_its_made:
Its made on Ronin chain. Presented by NODE.js with integration of trustell execution os oasis ROFL.
We built a complete auto-battler using Next.js + Socket.io for
  real-time gameplay, Ronin smart contracts for payments, and Oasis ROFL
   TEE for provably fair battle computation. The innovation is using TEE
   to solve the trust problem in blockchain gaming!


Frontend: Can deploy to Vercel
  - Game Server: VPS or cloud instance
  - ROFL: Running locally in Docker
